product.name: Urea
product.description: A nitrogen-based fertilizer produced in granular form for agricultural use, available in bagged or bulk formats.

product.name: Ammonia
product.description: A chemical product used as a raw material in fertilizer production and other industrial applications, with surplus sold commercially.

product.name: Green Ammonia Production Project
product.description: A project to produce ammonia using green hydrogen and renewable energy, targeting sustainable ammonia supply.

product.name: Melamine 40 Project
product.description: A planned production project for melamine, complementing existing urea production with an annual capacity of about 1,000 tons.

product.name: Polyethylene Pipes Manufacturing Project
product.description: A project to produce polyethylene pipes for natural gas and sewage systems to support national infrastructure plans.

product.name: Plastic Bags Manufacturing Project
product.description: A project to produce millions of plastic bags annually for domestic use and export to African and European markets.
